safety.title: Safety guide
safety.description: A few simple habits protect you, your community, and the value of the material you collect.
safety.doNotBurnDescription: Burning plastic-coated wires releases toxic smoke and can harm you and people nearby.
safety.batteriesDescription: Lithium-ion and lead-acid batteries can short-circuit, catch fire, or leak corrosive material.
safety.keepDryDescription: Store e-waste in a covered, dry area to reduce chemical leakage and material damage.
safety.separateDescription: Keep batteries, lamps, and damaged screens apart from general electronics until handover.
